relationships.subject: prelimbic prefrontal cortex
relationships.evidence_quote: At the cellular level, activation by BMI reduced the peak and cumulative firing rates of ACC pain responsive neurons after noxious stimulations

relationships.subject: closed-loop brain-machine interface
relationships.evidence_quote: BMI-triggered activation of the prelimbic PFC, meanwhile, reduced mechanical allodynia

key_findings: ACC spike decoding via a state-space model detects nociception and triggers optogenetic prelimbic PFC activation, inhibiting sensory and affective pain behaviours in acute and chronic pain models.
